note: Ps41 closes Book I (corrected method). Human IB: sakal wise compassion for the poor (esher blessed), David's confession (chata sinned, nefesh healed), enemies' inner malice (ra/shav/lev-aven/sane/chashab), the betrayal (shalom close friend, batach trusted, heel lifted - v9), tom integrity, barak blessing God. 6 God-acts (protect/keep-alive/gracious/heal/delight-in-me) = qualifiers. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: the one who considers the poor

'BLESSED (esher) is the one who considers the poor!' — the beatitude of the compassionate; esher (recurs Ps1,32,40) the happiness of the one whose regard for the weak God rewards with deliverance and protection
whom the LORD protects and keeps alive (v2)

'the one who CONSIDERS (sakal) the poor' — wise, attentive compassion for the weak; sakal = to act with insight, here the thoughtful care for the poor (dal) that God rewards (his protecting is the qualifier)
'considers the POOR (dal)' — the weak/helpless who are the object of the blessed one's care; dal = the low/thin, the poor whom the compassionate heed and God defends
the one who considers the poor

'he is CALLED BLESSED (ashar) in the land' — the public happiness of the compassionate; ashar (verb of esher) — the man whose care for the poor makes him esteemed blessed among men, not given up to his enemies' will
the blessed one (not given up to it)
deprecated ('you do NOT give him up to the will of his enemies')
'you do not give him up to the WILL (nefesh) of his enemies' — nefesh here as the enemies' greedy desire/appetite (cf Ps27:12); the blessed one protected from the foes' craving for his ruin

'heal me (nefesh), for I have sinned against you' — the soul needing healing because of sin; nefesh here the self David asks God to heal (God's healing = qualifier), the cure sought being for a sin-sick soul
the confessed ground of needing healing

'be gracious to me; heal me, for I have SINNED (chata) against you!' — the honest confession within the plea; chata here owned before God, sin acknowledged as the reason for the soul's sickness and need of grace
evil / malice (ra - enemies speak in malice)
'My enemies say of me in MALICE (ra), When will he die?' — the enemies' evil-hearted speech; ra here the malice wishing David's death and the perishing of his name, the inner venom behind their words
masking the heart that gathers iniquity

'when one comes to see me, he utters EMPTY (shav) words' — the hypocrite's hollow speech; shav (recurs Ps24,31) the vain/false words that hide a heart secretly gathering iniquity — sympathy on the lips, malice within

'while his HEART (lev) gathers iniquity' — the hypocrite's heart secretly hoarding malice; lev here the false visitor's inner reservoir of evil, at odds with his sympathetic speech, then spread abroad when he leaves
'his heart gathers INIQUITY (aven)' — the malice the hypocrite's heart amasses; aven (recurs Ps36) the mischief hoarded within to be published abroad against the sick man
'All who HATE (sane) me whisper together about me' — the conspiring hatred of the foes; sane (recurs Ps38:19) the enmity that gathers to whisper and plot the worst against the afflicted
'they IMAGINE (chashab) the worst for me' — the haters' calculated devising of evil; chashab (recurs Ps35,36,41) the scheming that plots David's ruin, imagining a deadly fate for him
'they imagine the WORST (ra) for me' — the calamity the foes devise; ra here the evil fate imagined ('a deadly thing... he will not rise again'), the doom they wish on the sick man
friend of peace / intimate (shalom - my close friend)

'Even my CLOSE friend (ish shalom - man of my peace), in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted his heel against me' — the deepest wound, betrayal by the intimate; shalom here the friend of one's peace, the trusted table-companion turned traitor (cited of Judas, Jn13:18)
'in whom I TRUSTED (batach)' — the misplaced human trust betrayed; batach here of trust in a friend (contrast trust in the LORD, Ps40:4) — the intimacy that made the betrayal cut deepest
grounded by God's grace to raise him up (v10)

'By this I KNOW (yada) that you delight in me: my enemy will not shout in triumph' — the assured inner knowledge of God's favour; yada here the confidence read from God's not letting the enemy triumph (God's delight = the qualifier)

'you have upheld me because of my INTEGRITY (tom), and set me in your presence forever' — the wholeness God honours; tom (recurs Ps25:21, 26:1) the sincerity that, despite confessed sin (v4), marks David as upheld and set forever before God's face
the LORD, the God of Israel

'BLESSED (barak) be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen' — the doxology closing Book I of the Psalter; barak the blessing of God, the eternal praise that seals the first book (framed with esher of v1)
rewards the one who considers the poor (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'the LORD PROTECTS (shamar) him and keeps him alive' - God's protecting is not a human IB char; it is the reward/source securing the one who considers the poor (278395). Qualifier.
rewards the one who considers the poor (v2)
v2 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'and keeps him ALIVE (chayah)' - God's preserving is not a human IB char; the source keeping the compassionate one (278395). Qualifier.
the grace sought for David's soul (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'O LORD, be GRACIOUS (chanan) to me; heal me' - God's graciousness is not a human IB char; the source David appeals to for his soul's healing (278455). Qualifier.
the healing sought for David's soul (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'HEAL (rapha) me, for I have sinned' - God's healing is not a human IB char; the cure David seeks for his sin-sick soul (278455). Qualifier.

v10 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'But you, O LORD, be GRACIOUS (chanan) to me, and raise me up' - God's graciousness is not a human IB char; the source grounding David's assurance that God delights in him (278410). Qualifier.
delight in (chaphets - God delights in me)

v11 QUALIFIER (God's disposition): 'By this I know that you DELIGHT (chaphets) in me' - God's delight in David is not a human IB char; it is the object of David's assured knowing (278410) - God's favour is the ground, David's knowing it is the IB. Qualifier.
v1: 'In the day of TROUBLE (ra) the LORD delivers him' - the calamitous circumstance from which the compassionate one is delivered; a time-of-trouble setting, not an inner operation. Standalone.
repay / requite (shalam - that I may repay them)

v10: 'raise me up, that I may REPAY (shalam) them' - David's stated purpose of requital on the foes; the intended action following restoration (the IB movement is the plea for grace, 278404). Standalone/purpose.
v11: 'my enemy will not SHOUT (rua) in triumph over me' - the foe's triumph-shout, denied; the sign by which David knows God's favour (278410). Standalone (the enemy's would-be triumph, prevented).
v5: 'When will he die, and his NAME (shem) perish?' - the enemies' wish that David's name be blotted out; the name/memory the foes want erased, part of their malice (278460). Standalone.
the betrayal act of the close friend (278491)
v9: 'has LIFTED (gadal) his heel against me' - the act of betrayal by the trusted friend; qualifies the close friend's treachery (278491) - the heel-lifting gesture of contempt/betrayal. Qualifier.
forever / eternity (olam - set me in your presence forever)

v12: 'set me in your presence FOREVER (olam)' - the everlasting duration of David's standing before God; a time-word qualifying the being-upheld (integrity, 278419), not an inner operation. Standalone.
v13: 'from EVERLASTING (olam) to everlasting' - the eternal span of the doxology's blessing of God (278423); a time-word, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v13: 'from everlasting to EVERLASTING (olam)' - the second eternity-word of the closing doxology (278423); a time-word, not an inner operation. Standalone.
